keyFindings.description: The new nested-decision case copies the setup of the existing reply case at :144-181 (project, issue, editArtifact insert of #storage, open_asks poll and guard, createComment with ask_id, decision/thread locators). Move the shared setup into one helper, e.g. replyUnderDocumentDecision(browser, title, body) returning { alice, page, thread }, and use it in both cases.

Security[untrusted-input] hardening: clientAttributes returns node.attributes unfiltered when the type is not found. That arm is unreachable today (typedBlockRefusal refuses an unknown name, block-schema.ts:234-235), but it fails open on the one place that drops forged server attributes. Pass the type the refusal check found, or throw, so the drop cannot be skipped silently.

The body leg finds the blank option with li:empty, which pins the text path's unwrap of a tight item's

. If that unwrap goes, the existing [&_li:has(>p:empty)]:hidden rule still hides the item but toHaveCount(1) fails. Select by position as the document leg does ([data-proof-block-content] > ul > li, count 2, nth(1)) and keep the display none check.
export type AskBlockStamps has no importer (only :195 and :207); the simplify pass made AskBlockShell and askBlockShell private. Drop the export.
remarkReadOnlyDirectives' doc repeats readOnlyDirective's rationale for the server-attribute drop (:158-162) nearly word for word. Keep it in one place and point to it from the other.
